class.name: VitaARMarkerTracker
class.brief_description: Detects the Vita camera demonstration marker and estimates its pose.
class.description: [Vita only] Lightweight fiducial tracker used by the Vita camera AR demonstration. It consumes an [Image] in [constant Image.FORMAT_L8], validates the asymmetric marker payload, corrects detected corners using the supplied camera calibration, and estimates a planar pose. This class is separate from [CameraServer] and is intended to validate camera capture, calibration, and projection. It is not a general-purpose marker tracker or SLAM implementation.

method.name: track
method.description: Detects the demonstration marker in [code]image[/code]. [code]calibration[/code] should be the dictionary returned by [method CameraFeed.get_calibration], and [code]marker_size[/code] is the measured black-square width in meters. The result always contains [code]found[/code] and [code]processing_usec[/code]. When found, it also contains canonical image-space [code]corners[/code], three camera-coordinate [code]rotation_columns[/code], [code]translation[/code] in meters, [code]marker_size[/code], and [code]confidence[/code].
